secrets.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the dashboard sign-in page (username defaults to `admin`, set in .env.base44-defaults). A public (non-loopback) bind always requires an auth provider.

secrets.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Session-signing secret for dashboard logins (>=16 bytes). Optional: without it each process start mints a random key and sessions do not survive a restart.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key used by the agent for model calls.
